objective: Create internal/next/contract/types.go with all exported core types: SpecScenario{Name, Given, When, Then, Notes string}, ScenarioContract{Scenarios []ScenarioAssertions}, ScenarioAssertions{Name string, Assertions []ContractAssertion}, ContractAssertion{FileExists string, FileContains *FileContainsAssertion, FileNotModified string, FileNotExists string, FileNotContains *FileContainsAssertion} with yaml omitempty tags, FileContainsAssertion{Path, Pattern string}, ContractFailure{ScenarioName, AssertionType, Details string}. Package is 'contract'. Include a package doc comment.

Create internal/next/contract/parse.go with exported func ParseScenarios(content string) []SpecScenario. Parse spec markdown by scanning for lines beginning with '### Scenario:' to find scenario boundaries. For each scenario block, extract: Name from the header (strip '### Scenario: ' prefix), and Given/When/Then/Notes blocks by matching '**Given:**', '**When:**', '**Then:**', '**Notes:**' labels (collect text until next label or next '### Scenario:' header). Skip scenarios missing BOTH When and Then (log warning to stderr). Given and Notes are optional. Return only valid scenarios.

Create internal/next/contract/parse_test.go with TestParseScenarios tests covering: (1) happy path — 2 valid scenarios with all blocks, correct Name/Given/When/Then/Notes extracted; (2) empty input returns empty slice; (3) scenario missing both When and Then is excluded from result; (4) scenario with When but no Then is excluded; (5) scenario with Then but no When is excluded; (6) Notes block optional — scenario included without it; (7) Given block optional — scenario included without it; (8) mix of valid and invalid scenarios — only valid ones returned.

Create internal/next/contract/evaluator.go with: (1) a GitRunner interface or func type for running 'git diff --name-only HEAD -- <path>' so the evaluator is testable without a real git repo; (2) FileSystemEvaluator struct with workDir string and a gitRunner func; (3) NewFileSystemEvaluator(workDir string) constructor using real git execution; (4) Evaluate(ctx context.Context, contract *ScenarioContract, workDir string) ([]ContractFailure, error) method: for each scenario's assertions, evaluate all 5 types — file_exists (os.Stat), file_contains (os.ReadFile + strings.Contains), file_not_modified (git diff --name-only HEAD -- <path>, empty output means unmodified), file_not_exists (os.Stat negated), file_not_contains (os.ReadFile + !strings.Contains). Check ALL assertions per scenario (no short-circuit). Each ContractAssertion must have exactly one field set; zero or multiple fields set returns an error. Paths are joined with workDir.

Create internal/next/contract/evaluator_test.go with tests for FileSystemEvaluator. Use a real temp directory (t.TempDir()) for filesystem assertions. Mock the git runner via a constructor parameter or function field. Tests: (1) TestEvaluate_FileExists_Pass and _Fail; (2) TestEvaluate_FileContains_Pass and _Fail with correct failure message format 'contract:<name> — file_contains failed: ...'; (3) TestEvaluate_FileNotExists_Pass and _Fail; (4) TestEvaluate_FileNotContains_Pass and _Fail; (5) TestEvaluate_FileNotModified_Pass (mock git returns empty) and _Fail (mock git returns filename); (6) TestEvaluate_EmptyAssertions returns no failures; (7) TestEvaluate_MultipleAssertionsPartialFailure: 2 assertions, one passes, one fails — both evaluated, only failure returned; (8) ContractFailure format uses em-dash separator: 'contract:<scenario-name> — <assertion-type> failed: <details>'.

Add ContractsWritten bool field with json tag 'contracts_written' to the RunState struct in internal/next/runstore/types.go. Place it logically near other stage-completion flags (e.g., near FinalValidationPassed). Do NOT add it to any per-cycle reset logic. Confirm internal/next/specloop/specloop.go does NOT reset ContractsWritten — read the file and verify the cycle-reset block (around line 42-50) does not reference ContractsWritten.

Add ContractsWrittenEvent and ContractsBlockedEvent types to internal/next/runstore/events.go following the existing pattern. ContractsWrittenEvent embeds BaseEvent and has ScenarioCount int json:'scenario_count'. ContractsBlockedEvent embeds BaseEvent and has Reason string json:'reason'. Register both in the unmarshalEvent switch with type strings 'contracts_written' and 'contracts_blocked'. The BaseEvent Type field should be set to the correct string in each event.

Create internal/next/specloop/stages/write_contracts.go implementing the WriteContracts stage. Include: (1) ContractWriter interface: WriteContracts(ctx context.Context, scenarios []contract.SpecScenario, specPacket string) (*contract.ScenarioContract, error); (2) WriteContractsStageConfig struct: Store runstore.Store, SpecPath string, EvidenceDir string; (3) WriteContractsStage struct with contractWriter ContractWriter, cfg WriteContractsStageConfig, eventLog *runstore.EventLog, budget interface with HardBudgetExceeded() bool; (4) NewWriteContractsStage constructor; (5) Name() returns 'write_contracts'; (6) Run(ctx, rs) logic: if rs.ContractsWritten return Continue; read spec file at cfg.SpecPath, call contract.ParseScenarios; if no scenarios return Continue; if budget exhausted return Blocked; attempt LLM invocation up to 3 times (max 2 retries): on each attempt call contractWriter.WriteContracts, validate YAML parseability and vocabulary (each ContractAssertion has exactly 1 field set using known keys), retry on failure passing error context; after 3 failures emit contracts_blocked event and return Blocked; on success: marshal to YAML, write to cfg.EvidenceDir/scenario-contracts.yaml, set rs.ContractsWritten=true, emit contracts_written event with scenario count, return Continue. Model tier: Sonnet (P1).

Create internal/next/specloop/stages/write_contracts_test.go with unit tests using a mock ContractWriter. Tests: (1) TestWriteContracts_HappyPath: valid scenarios in spec, writer returns valid contract, file written to EvidenceDir, rs.ContractsWritten=true, contracts_written event emitted with correct scenario count; (2) TestWriteContracts_Idempotent: rs.ContractsWritten=true on entry → immediate Continue, contractWriter never called; (3) TestWriteContracts_NoScenarios: spec file has no '### Scenario:' sections → Continue, no file written, writer never called; (4) TestWriteContracts_InvalidYAML: writer returns non-YAML string 3 times → Blocked, contracts_blocked event emitted; (5) TestWriteContracts_UnknownVocabularyKey: writer returns valid YAML with unknown assertion key (e.g., 'status: completed') 3 times → Blocked; (6) TestWriteContracts_BudgetExhausted: budget exhausted before invocation → Blocked immediately, writer not called. Use t.TempDir() for EvidenceDir.

Extend internal/next/specloop/stages/validate.go: (1) Add ContractEvaluator interface: Evaluate(ctx context.Context, contract *contract.ScenarioContract, workDir string) ([]contract.ContractFailure, error); (2) Add EvidenceDir string and Evaluator ContractEvaluator fields to ValidateStageConfig; (3) Update ValidateStage struct to store cfg including new fields; (4) In Run(): if cfg.Evaluator != nil and cfg.EvidenceDir != empty, check for scenario-contracts.yaml in EvidenceDir — if file does not exist, skip silently (not a failure); if file exists, parse YAML into ScenarioContract, call Evaluator.Evaluate(ctx, contract, workDir), convert each ContractFailure to failure string using format 'contract:<ScenarioName> — <AssertionType> failed: <Details>' and append to failures slice; run shell checks afterward regardless; combine all failures before deciding next action. Import internal/next/contract package for types.

Extend internal/next/specloop/stages/validate_test.go with contract evaluation tests using a mock ContractEvaluator. Tests: (1) TestValidate_ContractFailure: mock evaluator returns one ContractFailure, result is ReplanFrom with failure string matching 'contract:<name> — <type> failed: <details>'; (2) TestValidate_ContractAndShellBothFail: mock evaluator returns a failure AND shell validator fails — both failures appear in the replan context; (3) TestValidate_ContractFileMissing: EvidenceDir set but no scenario-contracts.yaml file present — no failure, evaluator not called; (4) TestValidate_ContractPassShellFail: contracts pass but shell validator fails — replan context contains only shell failure; (5) TestValidate_NilEvaluator: Evaluator field nil in config — no contract check, existing behavior unchanged. Use t.TempDir() for EvidenceDir when contract file present.

Create internal/next/contract/llm_writer.go with an LLM-backed ContractWriter implementation. The struct (e.g., LLMContractWriter) takes an llmadapter.LLMAdapter, formats a prompt instructing the LLM to translate the provided SpecScenarios and spec packet into a ScenarioContract YAML using only the valid vocabulary (file_exists, file_contains, file_not_modified, file_not_exists, file_not_contains), and parses the LLM response as YAML into *ScenarioContract. On error context retry, include the previous error in the prompt. Uses Sonnet (P1) tier. Then update cmd/gromit-next/stage_provider.go: (1) add noopContractWriter struct implementing ContractWriter with WriteContracts returning empty ScenarioContract; (2) construct writeContractsStage in BuildStages after planStage and before executeStage, using LLMContractWriter when provider available else noopContractWriter, passing store, cfg.SpecPath, and evidenceDir; (3) update validateStage construction to pass EvidenceDir and Evaluator (contract.NewFileSystemEvaluator(workDir)) in ValidateStageConfig. Import internal/next/contract package.

Create internal/next/specloop/contract_integration_test.go with //go:build integration tag in the specloop package. Tests exercise the WriteContracts → Validate pipeline using the scenarioStage pattern from existing integration tests (no real LLM). (1) TestIntegration_ContractFailureTriggersReplan: build a pipeline with a writeContracts scenarioStage that sets rs.ContractsWritten=true and writes a scenario-contracts.yaml with a file_contains assertion to a temp EvidenceDir, an execute scenarioStage that is a no-op (file never created), a ValidateStage with a real FileSystemEvaluator pointing at a temp workdir — Validate fails with 'contract:...' failure, replan triggered, second cycle WriteContracts is no-op (ContractsWritten=true), execute creates the file, Validate passes; (2) TestIntegration_ContractsPreservedAcrossReplan: on replan cycle, writeContracts stage never re-runs (ContractsWritten flag preserved), pipeline completes; (3) TestIntegration_NoContractFileSkipped: no scenario-contracts.yaml in EvidenceDir, ValidateStage with Evaluator skips silently, pipeline continues. Run with go test -tags integration.

Resolve both paths via filepath.EvalSymlinks before comparing in the test at cmd/gromit/run_spec_flag_test.go:116-121.
